notes.title: Graphics update for Erazer!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

With this update, we bring updated graphics for Erazer! All the existing official maps, as well as community maps will be getting a sharper look with new appearance for terrain and buildings. Experience the game with updated visuals with the latest patch!

notes.title: Content and quality update!
notes.notes:
Hello all!

With this update, you receive lots of new art and content for the game. Weapons and the game HUD have a new, better look. Additionally we have provided improvements on the gameplay as well as fixed bugs. The level editor now works more smoothly even on larger levels. Enjoy!

notes.title: Major gameplay and content update!
notes.notes:
Hi all!

With this update we introduce several new gameplay mechanics. It's now possible to grab opponents and follow up with several actions:
[list]
[*] Use the grabbed opponent as a shield against bullets
[*] Beat them down or strangle them quietly
[*] Throw them against other enemies to knock them down
[*] Drop them from higher areas to eliminate them
[/list]

We also bring in another new map, The Convict! This map puts you in a tough spot, captured in an enemy base. You need to break out and try not to be seen! If you are spotted, you will face much more resistance.

notes.title: All around improvements with update 81!
notes.notes:
With this update we bring improved quality all around the game:
[list]
[*] Much better water behavior and visuals
[*] Improved mission load screen
[*] Better mission selection screen
[*] Explosion traces on maps and background
[*] Showing reviews also for community maps
[*] Improved NPC behavior
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
-Fixed editor NPC sprites
-Fixed a bug, where level editor did not display player's maps
-Small performance improvements
-Updated lighting on many levels

notes.title: Game quality update
notes.notes: In this patch we bring better quality to several aspects of the game. We looked into lighting quality, animations, particles and the UI to bring better experience for all players. Enjoy the patch!

notes.title: Major graphics & gameplay update
notes.notes:
With this update, we provide a large overhaul to gameplay and graphics of the game. We have looked closely into animations, visuals, character movement and dynamic terrain to provide a better experience to the players of the game. This is the first update with the new systems and we will continue to improve on the work we present with this patch.

Earlier in the game, the player always spawned with a sword. Now, on default the player only has fists available, which creates more possibilities for level design and gameplay. The sword is now one of the unlockable weapons, and is provided as one of the first weapons as you proceed in the game.

We added animated arms to all the characters in the game. This allows more fluid movement and animation of the characters. We really like this change, and will continue to improve on the animations and unique movement with different weapons and gadgets.

We have also improved the graphics and effects in the game with this patch. The looks of the game are moving in a good direction and we are able to bring a more alive world with the new effects. This is one aspect we are looking to improve even more in the future, to provide a dynamic world with nice visual effects.

notes.title: Bug fixes and minor tweaks
notes.notes:
Regular update with small fixes and improvements
[list]
[*] More natural water resistance
[*] Improvements on functionalities when no internet connection is available
[*] Rain sound is now affected by SFX volume
[*] Syncing explosion sound for multiplayer
[*] Fixed slippery terrain wall sliding
[/list]
